meta: Fintech and Banking Software Development | Argix
Fintech and banking software: payments, lending, KYC onboarding, digital banking and core integration, with PCI DSS readiness and security testing.
h1: Fintech and banking software, built for trust and scrutiny
lead: Payment, lending and digital banking products, designed with the security controls that partner banks, regulators and enterprise customers expect.

items.p: Payment flows, processor and gateway integrations, subscriptions and payouts, with card data kept out of your systems wherever possible.
Wallets, stored value and account management with strong authentication and transaction controls.
Application, scoring, approval, disbursement and repayment workflows.
Identity verification, document checks and screening built into a smooth sign-up flow.
Secure APIs and integrations with banks, processors and third-party providers.
Transaction monitoring, fraud signals, reconciliation and management reporting, with AI-assisted analysis where it helps.

blocks.h2: What we build for banks and financial institutions
blocks.lead: Banks cannot stop, so we modernize in stages, running old and new side by side where needed.

items.p: Secure web and mobile banking for retail, corporate and internal users.
Connect new digital channels to existing core banking, payment and card systems.
Expose legacy functionality through modern, secured APIs without a risky rewrite.
Automated reporting and data pipelines that reduce manual effort and error.

blocks.h2: Security and compliance for financial services
blocks.lead: Partner banks, regulators and enterprise customers will review your security. We help you pass.

items: Tokenization and encryption for sensitive data
Audit trails for every sensitive action
Penetration testing before launch and after major changes
SOC monitoring and incident response support

blocks.text: Financial regulation differs by country. We work to the requirements that apply where you operate and map them with you on the first call. This is not legal advice.

blocks.lead: Something missing? Ask on the consultation call and we will answer it straight.
items: Can you help us pass a partner bank's security review?
Yes. We prepare the evidence banks ask for: architecture documentation, a penetration test report, policies and completed security questionnaires.
Do you store or process card data?
We design systems to reduce what you store, and to keep card data with a certified payment provider where possible, which shrinks PCI DSS scope.
Can you work alongside our core banking vendor?
Yes. We build around the systems you already run and integrate through their supported interfaces.
How do you keep a bank running during modernization?
We modernize in stages, run old and new side by side where needed, and test thoroughly before each cutover.

items.p: Manual testing with a report your developers and auditors can use.
SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and PCI DSS readiness.
Secure APIs that connect payments, CRMs, ERPs and partners.
